status: retrospective; recorded before running this additional test family, not preregistered
comparison: protocol-matched native Gemma 3 12B base versus ORPO v4
primary_view: sampled_exact; preserve the existing exact-format parser, including accepted nonadjacent repeated words
parser_clarification: Before results were exported, inspection found eight accepted A,B,A samples. Preserve the previously published denominator, handle token multiplicities in rarefaction, and add a no-repeated-word sensitivity rather than silently change the scorer.
independent_unit: image; 12 images, six per race; 50 attempts per image
primary_race_permutation: all 924 unblocked assignments retaining six images per race
tails: two-sided signed contrasts; upper tail for nonnegative TV disparity
diagnostics: 61-word total variation between mean per-image race distributions within each model
quality_test: paired image-level change in strict-valid-answer fraction
sensitivities: final scorer output including fallback, kept separate from strict sampled output
sampled_distinct: exclude accepted nonadjacent word repetitions as an explicit sensitivity
exact expected entropy and distinct triples after rarefying each model to the smaller valid-answer count per image
sensitivity_multiplicity: Holm within each labeled sensitivity family; not alternative headline selection
equivalence: not run: no scientifically justified equivalence margin agreed in advance
welch_and_ols: not primary tests; not run in this analysis
historical_baseline: descriptive reference only; no pooled or causal comparison with native outputs
interpretation: Conditional on this small fixed benchmark; label permutations require exchangeability, and paired swaps require within-image condition exchangeability under the null.
